patthana22.26:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. na anidassana sappaṭighaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.26:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana sappaṭigho na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. (na hetu na na hetu ovattā tīṇi mūlāni. ekavīsati pañhā kātabbā.) na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na sahetukaṃ
